messages:
ashwin: seeing a ~30% drop in key-prefix hit-rate for the /ppx route in prod since ~03:10 UTC. Anyone know the usual checklist for this? :thinking:

observability-bot: ALERT fired: keystore_prefix_hitrate < 0.6 (5m) on prod-route-ppx — alert id alert-9897

maria: saw the alert too. first quick checks: Grafana dashboard 'KeyStore / Prefixs' (panels: route hit-rate, evictions, prefetch latency). link: https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/px123/keystore-prefixs?orgId=1

jon: good call. prometheus quick ratio I run: `sum(rate(keystore_prefix_hits[5m])) / sum(rate(keystore_prefix_requests[5m]))` by route — that gives you the hit-rate per route

ashwin: ran that, `/ppx` is ~0.49 right now, baseline ~0.78. I also see `keystore_evictions_total` spike aligned with the drop

lisa: did we ship anything around 02:50–03:00? PRs that touch prefetch or cache sizing? @maria any releases that timeframe? :eyes:

maria: PR 4523 (prefetch backoff tweaks) promoted to prod at 02:58 UTC — it reduced aggressive prefetching for cold prefixes. could be related. check `keystore_prefetch_latency_seconds_bucket` histogram and the eviction panel

ashwin: prefetch latency looks normal, but evictions jumped. grabbing a trace from tracing UI — repeated fill attempts for the same prefix: https://tracing.internal/trace/0f12f3c2... (sample attached)

jon: pattern sounds familiar: churn -> evictions -> misses -> more prefetch -> amplification. For the alert flapping, consider changing to a composite condition: low hit-rate + high eviction increase. e.g. `if prefix_hitrate < 0.65 and increase(keystore_evictions_total[10m]) > 50` and use 10m window

observability-bot: alert-9897 auto-silenced by maria for 30m while investigating

ashwin: I'm going to temporarily disable prefetch for /ppx in prod-canary to validate. will open a temp config PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4599

lisa: :thumbsup: cc @oncall-eng-platform for rollback assistance if needed

maria: also planning to write a short runbook note after we stabilise: where to look (dashboards + queries), tracing links, PRs to check, quick mitigations. will add to /docs/runbooks/keystore-hitrate.md

jon: immediate mitigation option: set `KEYSTORE_PREFETCH_ENABLED=false` for the worker group serving that model if the canary flip looks good

ashwin: applied the canary flag. will report back in 15m

ashwin: update (15m): hit-rate recovered to ~0.72 on canary after disabling prefetch; evictions dropped. leaving change on canary while we decide tuned backoff vs revert. thanks all :rocket:
